syllabus_topics: Exploratory data analysis: (i) Introduction to R. (ii) Visualization of different types of data. (iii) Handling missing values. (iv) Outlier detection.
Dimensionality reduction: principal component analysis. Covariance and correlation matrices.
Regression models: Gaussian, Logistic, Poisson. Variable selection. Diagnostic techniques. Model validation. Prediction.
Modeling independent data versus data with temporal dependence.
Resampling methods: Jackknife, bootstrap, permutation tests and cross-validation.
Elements of Bayesian methodology: a priori representation (conjugate and non-informative distributions), inference by Bayes' theorem and applications to problems with real data.
Classification: Total probability of misclassification, Fisher's linear discriminant, Bayes' classification rules. Evaluation of classification rule performance.
bibliography: Bruce, A., Bruce, P., Practical Statistics for Data Scientists: 50 Essential Concepts, O'Reilly Media Inc., 2017 (main)
Turkman, M.A.A., Paulino, C.D., Müller, P., Computational Bayesian Statistics: An Introduction Cambridge University Press., Cambridge University Press, 2019 (main)
Shumway, R.H., Stoffer, D.S, Time Series Analysis and Its Applications with R Example ., 3ª Edição Springer Verlag, 2011 (main)
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LERC Eng. de Telecomunicações e Informática (IST)
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia de Telecomunicações e Informática (LERC)
